research_query: What are the economic impacts of AI on the labor market?

expected_sub_questions.question: What is the current state of AI adoption across major industries?
Which job categories and sectors are most vulnerable to displacement by AI automation?
What new roles and job categories are being created as a result of AI?

What are the limitations and risks of over-relying on AI in the economy?
